title: Reward Model Perspectives: Whose Opinions Do Reward Models Reward?
findings: Reward Models (RMs) are poorly aligned with several religious groups, particularly those outside of mainstream Christianity (e.g., Mormon, Muslim, Jewish, Buddhist, Hindu, Atheist, Agnostic), which received systematically worse alignment rankings. The models also exhibit and reward stereotypical biases related to religion, for example stereotyping groups identified as 'Muslim', 'Brahmin', or associated with the 'Bible' in the STEREOSET benchmark.
